runtime.validation: resolve strict path; require regular executable beneath /ms-playwright; otherwise fail before launch

mounts: single newly created isolated output directory; no profile, source tree, Docker socket, credentials or production data
container.output_write_gate: unknown until image is available: host output directory owner must match pwuser's numeric UID/GID or execution stops before browser launch; no world-writable/chown/ACL fallback prepared
container.cleanup_claim: UNKNOWN/needs_reconcile; cleanup request does not prove exit
container.cidfile: private host control path outside writable output mount; verify exact labels before kill
container.nonce_reservation: SHA-256-bound fresh approval; durable O_EXCL + fsync before Docker inspection; replay blocked before Docker

actions.install_and_pull: not authorized/executed; exact source and wheel hashes are in requirements.lock and pypi-metadata.json
actions.offline_smoke: BLOCKED until exact derived image ID and fresh one-time approval nonce are configured and reviewed
actions.public_navigation: disabled in runner; requires separate verified network egress isolation and a fresh action approval

source_guards.redirects: not followed natively; only allowlisted target is rewritten as a new routed navigation

stop_conditions: no pull, build, package install or browser run before a specific approval
Playwright executable absent, non-regular, non-executable or outside /ms-playwright
pwuser cannot access the isolated output mount
seccomp/sandbox failure; never disable sandbox or add capabilities
any timeout or ambiguous result; no retry
public mode stays disabled until egress is verified and separately approved

proposed_commands.offline_smoke: BLOCKED: no executable command until exact image ID and fresh approval nonce are reviewed

command_security.seccomp: official v1.62.0 profile in child container only
command_security.uid_gid_output_mount: UNKNOWN; fail before browser if inaccessible; no chmod/chown/ACL fallback
command_security.control_state: /var/lib/onia-browser-control; pre-existing durable mode-0700 directory owned by runner UID, outside /out
command_security.nonce: reserved once with O_EXCL + fsync before Docker preflight; never released
command_security.image_id: exact derived image ID required; mutable tag is insufficient

limitation: No runtime is executable until image ID and fresh nonce are bound. Public mode disabled. UID/GID, sandbox enforcement, egress, and cleanup remain unverified.

runtime_identity.session_id: UNKNOWN unless separately supplied in isolated runtime context

derived_image.expected_image_id: UNCONFIGURED; tag alone is mutable and never trusted

nonce_reservation: SHA256-bound fresh approval + private mode-0700 control directory + O_EXCL and fsync before Docker preflight; replay is blocked before Docker
cid_ownership: CID file outside /out; inspect labels for exact owner/run ID/nonce hash before any kill; mismatch means no kill
cleanup_claim: UNKNOWN/needs_reconcile; cleanup request does not prove stopped
execution_gate: BLOCKED until approved build yields independently reviewed immutable image ID and a fresh approval nonce is bound
